title: PAIR-CI: Calibrated Conditional Independence Testing for Causal Discovery with Incomplete Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.04838v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The standard constraint-based paradigm for causal discovery with incomplete data -- impute first, test second -- is frequently miscalibrated: any consistent conditional independence (CI) test rejects a true null with probability approaching 1 when imputation error induces spurious conditional dependence. We introduce PAIR-CI, a nonparametric CI test that restores calibration by integrating multiple imputation directly into the inferential procedure via a paired permutation design. PAIR-CI compares cross-validated models that include and exclude the candidate variable while receiving the same imputed conditioning set, so that imputation error cancels in their loss difference rather than contaminating the test statistic. A variance estimator that nests a provably consistent cross-validation estimator inside Rubin's rules yields inference that is asymptotically valid in the many-imputation limit and conservative by a derived, sign

translated_title: PAIR-CI：面向不完整数据因果发现的校准条件独立性检验
translated_abstract: 针对不完整数据的因果发现，标准的基于约束的范式——“先插补、后检验”——常常出现校准失准：当插补误差诱导出伪条件相关时，任何一致的条件独立性（CI）检验拒绝真原假设的概率都会趋近于1。我们提出了PAIR-CI，这是一种非参数条件独立性检验方法，通过配对置换设计将多重插补直接整合到推断过程中，从而恢复校准性。PAIR-CI比较包含与排除候选变量的交叉验证模型，同时两者接收相同的插补后条件集，使得插补误差在两者的损失差异中相互抵消，而不是污染检验统计量。一个方差估计量将一个可证明一致的交叉验证估计量嵌套于Rubin规则之内，由此得到的推断在多次插补极限下渐近有效，并且按照推导出的（符号……）保持保守。
tldr: 该论文提出PAIR-CI，一种通过配对置换设计将多重插补直接融入推断过程、使插补误差在损失差异中相互抵消的非参数条件独立性检验，从而解决了不完整数据因果发现中“先插补后检验”范式校准失准的问题。
en_tdlr: PAIR-CI is a nonparametric conditional independence test that restores calibration for causal discovery with incomplete data by integrating multiple imputation via a paired permutation design, so that imputation error cancels in the loss difference instead of contaminating the test statistic.
